request.amount_ada: none requested; proposed net change limit is 500,000,000 ada
request.deadline: Period begins at start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Record DRep agreement to a 500,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Count all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
The limit caps only the cumulative lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, fee allocations, refunds, and returns of funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the proposed limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit and are not reset, reversed, reopened, or re-authorized by this action.
The proposal states that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 has become practically constrained while still serving as a useful fiscal guardrail.
The proposal states that raising the limit to 500,000,000 ada preserves DRep ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals while maintaining a fixed guardrail and simple accounting.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal claims it complies with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and cites an IPFS reference for the constitution.
The proposal states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake record DRep agreement to the Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to raise and restate the Cardano Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 to 500,000,000 ada, with ledger-only withdrawal accounting, prior-period withdrawals included, no counting of inflows, no direct on-chain withdrawal authorization, and a claimed constitutional basis.
